body.faq_description: Common questions about our case studies, how we measure results, and what to expect when working with IGENTX.

faqs.question: Are these case study results verified?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every case study on this page documents a real IGENTX client engagement. Metrics such as traffic growth, load times and performance scores come from project delivery and analytics where available. Client quotes marked as verified are backed by the matching published case study.

faqs.question: What types of projects do you showcase?
faqs.answer: Our published case studies cover web development, SEO-driven growth, AI enquiry assistants and vertical product rollouts such as DaycareMate. We focus on outcomes that matter to businesses: leads, conversions, operational efficiency and launch speed.

faqs.question: Do you only work with UAE businesses?
faqs.answer: No. IGENTX delivers globally, with deep experience in the UAE market including bilingual Arabic and English websites, local SEO and compliance-aware delivery. Our case studies include UAE and international clients.

faqs.question: How long did these projects take to launch?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by scope. Focused marketing websites typically take 2 to 4 weeks. Larger projects with AI integrations, multilingual content or platform rollouts take longer. Each case study page outlines the challenge, approach and measurable results so you can see what is realistic for similar scope.

faqs.question: Can IGENTX deliver a website and AI agent together?
faqs.answer: Yes. The BloomWave case study is an example of a combined rollout: marketing website, 24/7 AI enquiry assistant and DaycareMate centre operations platform delivered by one team. We regularly combine web development with AI solutions when it supports lead capture and operational efficiency.

faqs.question: How do I get a proposal for a similar project?
faqs.answer: Book a free consultation through our contact page or email hello@igentx.com. We will discuss your goals, audience, timeline and budget, then recommend the right mix of web development, SEO, AI integration or custom software for your business.
